---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest an improvement or new capability
labels: enhancement
---

## Summary
A one-sentence description of what you want.

## Problem It Solves
What workflow or limitation does this address?

## Proposed Solution
How you think it could work. Rough is fine — diagrams, mockups, or just words.

## Alternatives Considered
Other approaches you thought about and why you ruled them out (if any).

## Additional Context
Anything else that would help evaluate this — examples from other tools, relevant engagement scenarios, etc.
